title: Sable and the Machine
author: Zephyrine Villalobos
blurb: Lena Villalobos, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
